all_contenders.name: Whiskers Harbour
all_contenders.reason: Rallied strongly from well back to finish runner-up by 0.2 lengths to Dandy's Gem at Belmont on August 19. Clint Johnston-Porter takes over the reins which is a notable jockey upgrade. Solid staying stamina for the 2200m journey.

all_contenders.name: Delicate Warrior
all_contenders.reason: Breakthrough winner over 2200m at Northam two starts ago before backing it up with a solid 4th beaten under a length at Belmont over 2100m. Holly Nottle claim provides helpful weight relief. Tactical presser who will be prominently placed.
